findings.description: The bucket has no server-side encryption configured. Sensitive data stored in this bucket would be stored in plaintext at rest, violating data protection guidance.
The bucket is public (comment notes it is public, and no private ACL or public_access_block is set), exposing stored data to unauthenticated access from the internet.
No bucket logging is configured, so there is no audit trail of access to the bucket's data.
The financials bucket has no server-side encryption configured, leaving financial data stored in plaintext at rest.
No bucket logging is configured, so there is no audit trail of access to the financials bucket.
The operations bucket has no server-side encryption configured, leaving stored data unencrypted at rest.
No bucket logging is configured, so there is no audit trail of access to the operations bucket.
The data_science bucket has no server-side encryption configuration, leaving stored data unencrypted at rest.
The object contains a customer-master spreadsheet stored without any server-side encryption on its bucket (aws_s3_bucket.data), exposing customer data in plaintext at rest.
